fields.title: Winner learning rate
fields.description: Set the winners learning rate which is used to adjust the winning cluster representative to the given data.

fields.title: Sister learning rate
fields.description:
Set the sisters learning rate which is used to adjust the sister-cluster representative of the winner to
the given data.

fields.title: Ancestor learning rate
fields.description:
Set the ancestors learning rate which is used to adjust the ancestor-cluster representative of the winner
to the given data.

fields.title: Stopping criterion
fields.description: Select which criterion is used to stop the growth of the tree.

fields.title: Minimal variability
fields.description:
Threshold for stopping tree growth when “Variability” is selected.
Lower values lead to more detailed clustering. A value of 0 means the algorithm will continue until each
data point forms its own cluster.
Note: Computing variability is computationally expensive for large datasets (O(n²)).

fields.title: Minimal resource
fields.description:
Threshold for stopping tree growth when “Resource” is selected.
Lower values lead to more detailed clustering. Values close to 0 result in very fine-grained clusters, but
the value must be greater than 0.

fields.title: Minimal error
fields.description:
Set the minimal error value to control the epochs per cycle. If the minimal error value is small, more
epochs will be needed to end a cycle. This means, that all cluster representatives will be pulled closer
to their data.

fields.title: Distance metric
fields.description:
Choose the euclidean or cosinus distance metric, to measure the distance between datapoints and cluster
representatives.

fields.title: Use hierarchical fuzzy data
fields.description:
Check to cluster hierarchical fuzzy rules hierarchically. The column with the fuzzy rule level has to be
selected in the drop down menu on the right. The input table needs at least one integer column for this
option being enabled. The drop down menu will be enabled when the checkbox is checked.

fields.title: Hierarchical level
fields.description:
If the checkbox on the left is checked, to cluster hierarchical fuzzy rules, the column with the fuzzy rule
level must be chosen by selecting it in the drop down menu. Only integer columns can be chosen for the
level.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Use class column
fields.description:
Check to use the class data specified by the drop down box below. The class data will be trained too for
the use of class prediction by the SOTA Predictor node. The input table needs at least one string column
for this option being enabled.

fields.title: Class column
fields.description: Specifies the column containing the class data. Only string columns can be chosen as class columns.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица
